en.title: Delhi Metro shuts 6 stations till 4pm amid Congress march; traffic curbs likely
en.summary: Six Delhi Metro stations including Rajiv Chowk, Central Secretariat and Patel Chowk will close entry and exit from 6 am to 4 pm Monday due to security concerns related to a Congress protest march planned to the Supreme Court. Interchange services remain available at affected stations.

en.title: Hyderabad man killed in Riyadh airport attack, two sons injured
en.summary: A man from Hyderabad was killed and his two sons were injured in an attack at Riyadh airport while the family traveled to Madinah following Umrah. His wife and daughter remain safe, though his aunt suffered head injuries.

stories.title: Dollar stays near 18-month high as Mideast conflict, inflation data in focus

en.title: Dollar stays near 18-month high as Mideast conflict, inflation data in focus
en.summary: The dollar remained near 18-month highs as markets responded cautiously to Middle East geopolitical tensions and disrupted Saudi infrastructure. Investors monitored oil price fluctuations and prepared for upcoming US consumer price index data that could influence Federal Reserve policy decisions.

stories.title: FMCG revenues to rise in Q2, but costs could dent margins

en.title: FMCG revenues to rise in Q2, but costs could dent margins
en.summary: India's fast-moving consumer goods sector is expected to achieve double-digit revenue growth in the September quarter through increased sales volume and pricing strategies. Rising raw material costs for items like sugar and edible oils may pressure profit margins during this period.

stories.title: RBI measures may boost local bond demand amid rupee pressure

en.title: RBI measures may boost local bond demand amid rupee pressure
en.summary: Recent Reserve Bank of India actions to stabilize the rupee may encourage Indian companies to return to the bond market, which had seen reduced activity due to high overseas yields and hedging costs. Bonds could become a more attractive financing option as bank borrowing costs rise.

stories.title: Once-hot AI trade leaves Korean stocks struggling for buyers

en.title: Once-hot AI trade leaves Korean stocks struggling for buyers
en.summary: South Korea's stock market has declined 22% from its peak and ranks as the worst performer in the second half of the year following its earlier artificial intelligence sector boom. Trading turnover has collapsed by 70%, triggering withdrawals from both foreign and domestic investors.
